description: Searches floor plans across the reviewed launches, a selection during the trial. Filter by property type (condo or ec), bedrooms, size in square feet, postal district, launch stage, features such as a kitchen window, and a maximum budget in Singapore dollars. Plans in matches meet every constraint you supplied; plans in close miss exactly one, or could not be checked on one, as shown in each plan's fit (met, missed or unknown). The close list holds at most 20 plans, those with the fewest unknowns first; close_total says how many came close and close_truncated whether some were left out, so narrow the filters to see them. Cull both lists against what your user actually wants. Each result gives the plan, its stacks (stacks_note explains an asterisk), a link to the plan image, and a price with its kind and date. When nothing matches or comes close, the reply names which filters excluded the plans. Prices are guidance from developer price lists: indicative before launch, reset on booking day, and subject to promotions afterwards. Treat them as a starting point and confirm with the agent. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

include_sold_out.description: Include sold-out launches. Not scored as a constraint.

property_types.description: condo or ec. Leave out to include both.

name: search_floor_plans
